title: Tomas's Kite for the Spring Festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Tomas wakes up excited about the spring festival happening this afternoon. His grandmother Abuela is in the kitchen making breakfast. Tomas tells her about the big kite-flying contest. Abuela smiles and says they can build a kite together right now.'>>

choices.label: Start building right away
Tell Abuela they won't have enough time

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas worries they won't have time to build and test. Abuela smiles and shows him special sticks and string she saved for months. She says she was waiting for the right day to build with him.'>>

choices.label: Feel hopeful and start the building

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='At the kitchen table, Tomas and Abuela sketch kite designs. Tomas suggests a big diamond kite. Abuela mentions a traditional box kite from her childhood. They could also try a simple triangular design.'>>

choices.label: Build the diamond kite
Build the box kite
Build the triangle kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=72 beats='Tomas and Abuela gather two long sticks and string from the garage. They cut old plastic bags and tie them to the sticks. Abuela shows Tomas how to knot the flying string carefully. The kite comes together quickly.'>>

choices.label: Launch the diamond kite in the field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=74 beats='Building a box kite is trickier. Abuela finds four sturdy sticks and they shape them into a square frame. Tomas helps wrap colored tape at the corners. They attach cloth panels with strong twine. It's sturdy and impressive.'>>

choices.label: Take the box kite outside to test

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas picks three sticks and arranges them in a triangle. Abuela ties them at the corners with twine. They stretch light cloth over the frame. Abuela says simple designs often catch wind the best.'>>

choices.label: Test the triangle kite outside

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=73 beats='They go to the field behind Abuela's house. The morning wind is soft and gentle. Tomas holds the kite while Abuela unwinds string. Tomas releases it. The kite wobbles at first then catches the wind and starts to climb.'>>

choices.label: The kite soars high and steady
The kite spins and crashes

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=72 beats='The kite dances in the wind and climbs higher. Tomas laughs as he holds the string steady. But then the wind suddenly shifts direction. Clouds roll across the sky. The wind is becoming unpredictable and strong.'>>

choices.label: Keep flying and learn how the kite responds
Bring it down carefully to study the design

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The kite crashes to the ground. Tomas runs to pick it up. One stick is cracked. Abuela kneels beside him and points out where the frame weakened. They need to think about what went wrong.'>>

choices.label: Rebuild with stronger materials
The kite is too broken to fix in time

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The wind becomes strong and choppy. The kite jerks hard on the string in Tomas's hands. It swings wildly side to side. Tomas holds tight. His arms strain but he doesn't let go. Abuela cheers. Then the wind eases and the kite steadies again.'>>

choices.label: The kite feels ready for the festival
The wind was too unpredictable to trust it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=71 beats='They bring the kite down and sit in the grass. Abuela traces her finger along the frame and cloth. She talks about how wind pushes differently on different parts. The kite shows promise but needs a little work.'>>

choices.label: Make small improvements to the design
Take it to the festival as it is

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=69 beats='Abuela finds a spare stick in her craft box. She shows Tomas how to lash it to the cracked stick with strong twine. Tomas holds both sticks steady. The frame feels solid again. Maybe this will work.'>>

choices.label: Quick test of the repaired kite
Trust the repair and head to the festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Abuela brings tape and twine. They wrap extra bands around the corners where the kite shows stress. Tomas helps reinforce where frame meets cloth. The kite now feels much sturdier. They nod to each other. It's ready.'>>

choices.label: Head to the festival with the improved kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Back in the field, Tomas launches the repaired kite. It climbs more smoothly than before. The wind is gentler this time. The kite floats steadier. The repair held strong. Tomas grins at Abuela.'>>

choices.label: Head to the festival now

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Tomas looks at the kite they made together. It has repairs and patches but it's theirs. Abuela puts a hand on his shoulder and says the best kite is one you make with someone you love. Tomas feels ready. They pack up and head out.'>>

choices.label: Head to the spring festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='Tomas and Abuela arrive at the spring festival. The field fills with children flying colorful kites. The contest is starting. Tomas holds his kite proudly. He feels nervous and excited. Every lesson they learned prepares him for this moment.'>>

choices.label: Launch and the kite dances perfectly
Launch and the kite flies well
Launch but something goes wrong

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='Tomas's kite rises high and graceful. It stays airborne longer than most others. The judges watch carefully. When the wind shifts, the kite adapts beautifully every time. Tomas wins the blue ribbon. Abuela hugs him tight. They celebrate under the festival sun together.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=78 beats='Tomas's kite flies well and stays in the air during the contest. It doesn't win first place but the judges notice it. They give special recognition for teamwork and creative effort. Tomas feels proud. Winning wasn't everything. Building something together mattered most.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=76 beats='The kite wobbles and falls during the contest. Tomas feels disappointed. But Abuela reminds him of everything they discovered together. They learned and worked hard. Failure taught them more than success could. Next year they'll build something even better.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=74 beats='Tomas and Abuela look at the broken kite. The damage is too much to fix quickly. They sit down together and talk about what they tried. They built something and learned together. Sometimes things don't go as planned and that's okay.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=73 beats='The unpredictable wind worried Tomas. He and Abuela decide they're not confident enough to fly it in the contest today. They laugh knowing they built something wonderful anyway. They can try again when Tomas feels ready. Today was good enough.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=72 beats='Tomas and Abuela accept that their design has limits they can't fix in time. That's okay. They learned valuable lessons about wind and balance and how to work together. Every effort teaches something. Abuela says learning is more important than winning.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=75 beats='Tomas and Abuela stand back and look at their finished kite. It's solid and well-built. They feel confident about it. Walking to the festival together, they talk about all the choices they made. Good design and hard work feel like they have a real chance.'>>
